name: S4-D220 dist blank parse returns dashes again
note: NAMED TRIP: g237_d220_distzero.js row D220-zero only (_iawParse('dist','') is ['','','']; hand ['0','0','0']). The mutated line is the blank-string line of _iawParse (if(!s) return kind==='pace'?...): its dist arm returns dashes, its rept arm ['0','0'] and pace arm ['',''] keep today's values; the malformed line (m3) is untouched.
